sources: Authenticated workspace recorded one-minute candles, retrieved 2026-11-05
rule: Only directional pullback participation: move maturity >4.25 ATR and nearest earlier observed opposing level <0.5 ATR away require a directional completed close strictly beyond the preceding four-bar high (CE) or low (PE).
thresholdSelection: Existing maturity budget and limited-room warning, fixed before comparing outcomes. No threshold search.
limitations: Daily diagnostics returns its last 500 decisions. Earlier linked snapshots not returned are unassessed, not missing from the database and not presumed retained.
Recorded candles were queried retrospectively; matching decision closes were checked, but full original OHLC input hashes are unavailable in this comparison.
Only completed candles up to each recorded decision were used; later outcomes were attached after applying the rule.
Other entry paths, new subsequent entries, changed exit timing, occupancy, spreads and counterfactual fills were not simulated. This is not a measured change in portfolio P&L or expectancy.
November 5 motivated the hypothesis; November 2-4 are earlier cross-session comparisons, not independent forward validation. Sample is too small and bounded to establish profitability.
conclusion: Corrects the weak-confirmation condition but also filters winners. Not evidence of consistently superior net performance; retain local pending review and full CI.
